title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to 9646e2ed2bf3 (objectui#12185, objectui#12183) (#15204 C9)
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: no

**The console pin hop `088e0f705520` → `9646e2ed2bf3`** (objectui `main`, `9646e2ed2bf315a6ae99b2a1633bc7c7d162f7b9`, exactly that commit). This hop exists for objectui#12185 (`d928c8394`, objectui#12183). Under a wall (`isolated` / `group`), Setup's security catalog pages (position, permission set, capability) are read-only for a tenant and say why, while the platform operator keeps write. The server already refuses those writes (#22895, #22935).

**Tier:** no governed surface (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`). 20 files.

## The hop: 9 objectui commits, all on objectui `main`

- `d928c8394`, objectui#12185 (objectui#12183): under a wall, the catalog pages are read-only for a tenant and say why;
- `9646e2ed2`, objectui#12193: the fallback email-template form stops offering the retired `category` / `isSystem` keys;
- `5dd583f5e`, objectui#12199: a gallery card whose title field is a lookup draws the referenced name;
- `26b0bd2d1`, objectui#12189, and `35a2b59a5`, objectui#12180: objectui#6349 batches 12 and 11 (one authority each for the FilterBuilder types, `DataSource`, `DomProps`, `SchemaNode`);
- `5b20aed39`, objectui#12181: a hatch-elevated type's packaged item opens read-only;
- `b0c5f9ddf`, objectui#12177: Studio names an environment overlay, not an org overlay;
- `0f31c3a03`, objectui#12186 (CLI test) and `7e30d0b6e`, objectui#12182 (docs deploy CI): ship no console code.

## The pin round, as #22967's

**Console Pin Gate steps, run locally** (each exited 0):
1. Client build: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...`.
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the pin.
3. `check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@9646e2ed2bf3)".
4. `check:console-injection --require-stamp`.

**Artefacts that travel with the pin:**
- **Console changeset.** `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` generated `.changeset/console-9646e2ed2bf3.md`: `@objectstack/console` **minor**, the level #22967 used (also the level the script derived from objectui's own changesets). It has 13 releasing entries and 0 breaking, so there is no ADR-0087 placeholder. One commit carries no changeset and is listed by subject. `Clause-②: no` was added by hand, as in #22967. `check:objectui-changeset` passes.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical across the hop (107 components), and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is re-recorded at the pin. `check-sdui-manifest` passes.
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `9646e2ed2bf3`. objectui's `sdui-parser` changed on this hop (objectui#12180's type renames), and `check:sdui-lockstep` still passes: 214 grammar lines are byte-identical, all 25 diagnostic codes agree, and the `not-a-container` predicate agrees. **No parser port is owed.**
- **Pin citations, re-measured for this hop only** (re-measure, never find-and-replace):
  - one file that any record cites changed on the hop: `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (+9/-9, objectui#12189, the FilterBuilder group type's rename). All nine lines were replaced in place (`:13`, `:324`, `:326`, `:332`, `:399`, `:756`, `:774`, `:777`, `:1558`), so **no line in the file moved** and no cited range contains a changed line. Its `case 'kanban'` / `'calendar'` / `'timeline'` / `'gantt'` / `'map'` / `'tree'` arms held at `3762` / `3813` / `3902` / `3959` / `4079` / `4120-4144`. `resolveListMapConfig` `:209-214` and `resolveTimelineDateBinding` `:695-699` held too, each ending before the next changed line below it;
  - the records citing it got hand-written hop sentences: the four view-type rows of the functional-completeness table (`calendar`, `gantt`, `timeline`, `map`), plus the `object-gantt` and flat-`TreeConfig` records in `component.zod.ts`. The `kanban` row-cap record names `ListView.tsx` / `ObjectView.tsx` only as an earlier re-read's record, and its sentence says so;
  - every other record cites only files that are byte-identical across the hop, and each gains a hop sentence saying so. Every cited objectui file was resolved against the tree at the pin and checked with `git diff --quiet 088e0f705520 9646e2ed2bf3 -- <path>`, one file at a time; bare names (`index.tsx`, `types.ts`, `button.tsx`) were resolved by their record's context. That covers `form.tsx`, `autoLayout.ts`, `field-type-alias.ts`, `ObjectCalendar.tsx`, the `en` / `zh` / `de` packs, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` and the action renderers, so the `FormField.span` describe's claim holds (pin re-stamped, `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` regenerated by `check:generated --fix`, the only stale artifact);
  - the six migration entries were recounted with `git grep -o -F`, which reproduces every `088e0f705520` figure exactly. The corpus is 8540 files, and every retired name each entry counts still reads 0. A superset was counted to be safe: every current export of `plugin-lifecycle-advanced.zod.ts`, `metrics.zod.ts` and `tracing.zod.ts`, plus every key each entry names. Every term is 0 except the unrelated `Span` 519 / `SpanSchema` 57, which the tracing entry already explains and which are unchanged. The lit controls moved with the corpus, e.g. `objectstack` 18400 → 18438, `tenant` 1365 → 1393;
  - `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors`: 55 asserting citations match `9646e2ed2`, and the 13 quoted anchors verify against objectui at the pin. `gen:migration-registry` regenerates the six generated-registry rows;
  - changeset `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-9646e2ed2bf3.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

## Browser check, against this branch's built console

`examples/app-showcase` was booted `--fresh` on this branch's console dist (Playwright, Chromium), once per posture. **Harness note:** as committed, the showcase cannot boot walled. It does not declare `@objectstack/organizations`, and the CLI refuses a walled posture without it (ADR-0093 D5). A walled boot also needs `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and a declared `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`. For the `isolated` and `group` runs I added the dependency to the showcase's `package.json` locally and uncommitted, set `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`, and reverted both files afterwards. `/auth/config` served `tenancyPosture: isolated` / `group` with `degradedTenancy: false`.

**Tenant fixture (each walled run):** `tenant@wall.test` owns organization "Tenant A". The operator authored a runtime permission set `w_meta_author` (`manage_metadata`) and a runtime position `wall_demo_pos`, and granted `w_meta_author` to the tenant inside Tenant A. The tenant's `/auth/me/permissions` carries `manage_metadata`, and its session reads `isPlatformAdmin: false`. The server refuses the tenant's `PUT /meta/position/wall_probe` with `403 FORBIDDEN` naming the posture.

| | position list / editor | permission-set list / editor | capability list / editor |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **`isolated`, tenant** | no New; `catalog-readonly-reason`; editor `walled-catalog-readonly-banner`, no Design / Save / Delete, Delegatable switch disabled | no New; reason line; editor `perm-walled-readonly`, badge "Read-only (the platform operator defines this catalog)", no Save / Clone | read-only by the package lock ("locked … `com.example.showcase@0.1.0`"), the type's own tier, as objectui#12185 specifies for a stock capability |
| **`isolated`, operator** | New offered; editor in Design with editable fields and the save / delete affordances | New offered; editor offers Save | read-only (code-only type: the server refuses a runtime capability for everyone, `allowRuntimeCreate=false`) |
| **`group`, tenant** | as `isolated` | as `isolated` | as `isolated` |
| **`group`, operator** | as `isolated`; **a label edit auto-saved**: `PUT /meta/position/wall_demo_pos?mode=draft` → 200 | as `isolated` | as `isolated` |
| **`single`, non-operator `manage_metadata` holder** (`author@single.test`, `isPlatformAdmin: false`) | New offered, editor editable, no wall notes; **a label edit auto-saved**: `PUT …?mode=draft` → 200 | New offered; editor offers Save | read-only (type tier, as before) |

The one enabled switch on the tenant's permission-set editor is the matrix's "Only granted" view filter, not a write.

**User page grant pickers** (`single`, as the operator, on `author@single.test`'s record): the Positions tab's New opens the grant form, and `registry-ref-position` lists 17 positions (16 stock plus `wall_demo_pos`). The Permission Sets tab's New opens `registry-ref-permission`, which lists 18 permission sets. Picking `auditor` and `showcase_auditor` and pressing Create wrote both rows (`POST /data/sys_user_position` → 201, `POST /data/sys_user_permission_set` → 201), confirmed through the data API. **`everyone` is still listed** among the positions: the open objectui finding #22967 carried, unchanged by this hop.

Also seen, not this hop's: a fresh workspace opens the "Set the workspace timezone" dialog over Setup until it is dismissed.

## Verification (local)

- full `turbo run build` green (74/74, none cached);
- `check:generated`: 14/14 current after the `view.mdx` regeneration;
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 125 derived families. The sweep was running when this draft opened, and its verdict follows in a comment.
